hero.title: Shaping honest songs from first spark to master.
hero.subtitle: Studio productions, artist collaborations, and an evolving vault of raw musical sketches curated from studio sessions and Instagram Song Ideas.

studio.name: Jupiterkade 2 Studio
studio.summary: A focused songwriting and production room in The Hague built around feel, vocal presence, and unhurried arrangement.
studio.approach: Every production starts with serving the core emotion of the song - pairing tactile acoustic instruments, warm analog-inspired textures, and subtle rhythmic movement so artists sound unmistakably like themselves.
setupHighlights: Vocal chain tuned for intimate, unforced lead performances
Acoustic guitars, Rhodes/keys, tactile upright & analog synth textures
Full arrangement, drum programming, and hybrid mixing under one roof

services.title: Full Track & Album Production
services.description: Guiding a song from voice memo or acoustic demo through arrangement, tracking, instrumentation, and final mix.

services.title: Co-Writing & Song Development
services.description: Focused studio writing sessions to unlock melodies, chord movement, structure, and lyrical clarity.

services.title: Arrangement & Sonic Direction
services.description: Stepping in on existing demos to elevate dynamics, harmonic tension, vocal layering, and overall cohesion.

services.title: Sync & Bespoke Song Starters
services.description: Developing original cues or adapting raw sketches from the Song Ideas vault for artists, film, and visual storytelling.

chapters.title: Acoustic & Soul Sketches
chapters.description: Intimate guitar figures, warm Rhodes progressions, and vocal-ready song starters rooted in soul and alternative pop.

chapters.title: Synth & Texture Studies
chapters.description: Atmospheric pads, tape-warmed chord loops, and late-night melodic motifs captured straight from the studio desk.

chapters.title: Rhythmic Beds & Grooves
chapters.description: Pocket-driven drum sketches, basslines, and percussive frames ready to build top-lines and full arrangements around.
